# Marilla Cuthbert & Rachel Lynde

Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes a dressed-up [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in a buggy and visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) out of curiosity. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and concern over the risks of adoption before departing to spread the news.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but offends her with blunt remarks about her red hair and looks. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flies into a fiery rage, shouting at Mrs. Lynde before storming off to her bedroom. After Mrs. Lynde leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. Lynde, who forgives her completely and gives her flowers. As [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a warm surge of affection for the girl despite her theatrical nature.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during the night, earning Mrs. Barry's gratitude and restoring her friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert with their classmates, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), unaware that Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) is sleeping in it. The surprise causes [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) to react angrily, threatening to cut short her visit and cancel Diana's music lessons until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take responsibility.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) admits her fault to Mrs. Lynde before walking over to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Anne's brave and earnest explanation amuses [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue Diana's music lessons. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) become great friends during her month-long stay.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional after Mr. Phillips's farewell speech and eager about the arrival of Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) prepares to host the new minister and his wife for tea, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) making a layer cake for Mrs. Allan. However, during the tea party, Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice a strange taste in Anne's cake.
>

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> Noticing how plainly [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is dressed compared to her friends, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) attempts to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a store, though he ends up flustered and gets help from Mrs. Lynde instead. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the stylish dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as well as a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). She later wears her new outfit to the school concert, where she performs brilliantly.
>

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return next year to prepare the class for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts away her books for the summer to enjoy her childhood, while Mrs. Lynde visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises Anne's remarkable growth and improvement over the past three years.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxiously awaits the results of the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes over to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the newspaper showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. Lynde before going to sleep feeling grateful.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing eyesight will force her to sell [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let her sell, giving up her college scholarship to stay home, teach, and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. Lynde later reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could teach close to home, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is interrupted while studying on her doorstep by her angry new neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), whose oatfield was invaded by Anne's cow. After arguing with him, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pens the cow up and later discusses the incident and village gossip over tea with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P4](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028)_

> Mrs. Lynde expresses her skepticism about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), as well as Anne's plans to start a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite Mrs. Lynde's warning that people dislike being improved, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remains determined to pursue the idea alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Mrs. Lynde also shares that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) has been hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P52](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0052), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate the ethics and effectiveness of corporal punishment in school teaching on the eve of the school year. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxious about her upcoming first day of teaching.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day of teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, meeting her students—including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and the imaginative [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)—and dealing with minor classroom infractions. After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands about her children's names, but [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up by gifting her wild orchids. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her day with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.
>

> In a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares amusing stories and student compositions from her teaching job. She recounts humorous classroom incidents, answers to her creative prompts, and includes compositions written by her students, notably admiring [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's imaginative letter about his fictional rock friends.
>

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

> Mrs. Lynde tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about preparations for the Ladies' [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar and asks to borrow Miss Barry's platter, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns Marilla's sight is improving. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle extending their stay, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted ads, prompting a committee of girls to try unsuccessfully to talk him out of it.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), covered in feathers and having accidentally dyed her nose red, quickly cleans herself up. With help from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful and delightful visit for her distinguished guests.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042)_

> Uncle Abe's storm prediction comes true with violent force, bringing a devastating hail storm to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the twins rush home from school as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) suffers broken windows and stripped vegetation. The storm kills Mr. Harrison's parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) and ruins local crops and young trees, though [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) find solace in the fact that Mr. Boulter's unsightly old house burned down.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn that Mr. Harrison's long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after seeing a newspaper joke about his supposed remarriage. Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) investigates the situation, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to hear his side of the story.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P32](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0032), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)_

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated in the past over household neatness, grammar nagging, and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) with Mrs. Lynde, welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) radiantly, and later admits her own past foolishness as she walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home. Back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Mrs. Lynde comments on the situation before leaving, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts a sleepy [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can go to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts the plan and resigns her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> The A.V.I.S. throws a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, though Anne's evening is somewhat ruined by Gilbert's sentimentality and Charlie Sloane's dull company. The next day, after dealing with discouraging goodbyes from local women, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a peaceful evening walk in the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), restoring her spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P38](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0038)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is warmly greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who whisks her away to their new boardinghouse and helps lift her homesick spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. Upon her arrival, she receives a enthusiastic welcome from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Lynde, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who builds a bonfire for her. Before bed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) work through his guilt over wanting to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P18](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0018), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with a dying [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of death and her unfulfilled dreams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers quiet comfort, and Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a snowbound [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday and finds Gilbert's visits increasingly uncomfortable. She worries about being able to afford her next year at college until she receives a letter announcing a thousand-dollar legacy from the late Miss Josephine Barry.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

_Sources: [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P21](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0021), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a June evening. After cheering up [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his schoolwork, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) listens to Mrs. Rachel talk about Aunt Atossa's funeral and Diana's upcoming wedding. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later wanders down to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), reflecting mournfully on growing up, losing Diana's close companionship, and her strained dynamic with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

_Sources: [v3 ch.Evening P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000), [v3 ch.Evening P9](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0009), [v3 ch.Evening P13](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0013), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding, reminiscing about their childhood vows of friendship and future plans. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives to walk [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the parlor for the ceremony and then accompanies her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) afterwards, taking a moonlight stroll through Lovers' Lane.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P4](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0004), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after rejecting [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), but learns from [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) that he recovers quickly from heartbreak. She hears [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde, clashes with Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) over Jane's lavish engagement, and attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her newborn baby, feeling increasingly lonely as her friends move on into new stages of life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to hear from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her true feelings for him. In the morning, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote passes by and informs her that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
